title: MVRP Framework: φ-Geometry Effects on Physical Coherence
description: Protocols, data, analysis tools and documents for the Minimum Viable Recursion Protocol (MVRP) tests of golden-ratio (φ) electrode geometry. Results are preliminary and unreplicated (N=5–7, single unblinded operator); null results are reported. Code under MIT, data and documents under CC-BY 4.0.
